13 May 2026

The Australian Government has released the 2026-27 Budget. This notice provides guidance on planned issuance of Australian Government Securities by the AOFM. 

Based on Budget forecasts, issuance of Treasury Bonds (including Green Treasury Bonds) in 2026-27 is expected to be around $125 billion. Issuance of Treasury Indexed Bonds by tender is expected to be between $2 billion and $3 billion (additional issuance by syndication may be considered).

For 2025-26, issuance of Treasury Bonds (including Green Treasury Bonds) has been revised to around $120 billion. Treasury Indexed Bond issuance will be around $3 billion.

The AOFM will remain active in the Treasury Note market with regular issuance for cash management purposes.

Details of weekly transactions will continue to be announced at midday on the preceding Friday.

Further guidance on 2026-27 issuance plans will be provided on 26 June 2026.
